newsitem.title: USA: GM's Chevrolet sets 1997 Corvette price.
newsitem.headline: GM's Chevrolet sets 1997 Corvette price.

text.p: General Motors Corp's Chevrolet division said Monday it set a manufacturers' suggested retail price of $38,060 for its 1997 Corvette, which features more than $1,200 worth of premium standard equipment.
The Corvette price is up $270 from the $37,790 suggested price for its 1996 predecessor.
The additional premium standard equipment for 1997 include a premium sound system, low pressure warning for tires, driver's power seat, speed sensitive steering and extended mobility tires.
Chevrolet added that the 1997 Corvette uses 34 percent fewer parts and is lighter than its predecessor.
The all-new Corvettes will be unveiled at more than 400 dealerships in late February, Chevrolet said.
